The scene represents a fork of road in the countryside, at the entrance of a village. To the left a road that is lost between the scenes, elbows in the center of the scene and continues in a boulevard surrounded by trees that goes towards the right in perspective. At the end of the boulevard you will see, between the trees, two or three little houses. To the point where the road makes elbow, in the steep ground, a big tree; behind it a shortcut, practicable path that starts from the avenue towards the plants of the scenes on the left. Almost before the tree, on the street, is planted a pertic roughness, at the top of which waves a flag, as is used for the popular holidays; and further down, at the end of the boulevard, you will see two or three rows of lampposts of coloured paper suspended through the way from one tree to the other.
